messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

This risk occurs when people start using the medication.
Bupropion may impair your thinking or reactions.
Be careful if you drive or do anything that requires you to be alert.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it?
